## Problem and purpose

What problem does this address, and why does it matter?

## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior or documentation improvement.

## Related issue

Link the relevant issue. Use `Closes #...` only when its full acceptance criteria are met.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks performed and their results. Include screenshots for visible UI changes, using synthetic data.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the documentation matches the implementation.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or any unrun/failed checks are explained.
- [ ] No credentials, personal records, or generated reports were committed.
- [ ] Remaining limitations and follow-up work are identified.
